en.headline: Citybus extends B14 to all-day service on trial from Saturday
en.dek: The Kai Tak to Huanggang Port express route will run throughout the day until 1 November, with northbound services from 8am to 9pm.
body: Citybus will extend its B14 route between Kai Tak, Sung Wong Toi and the new Huanggang Port to all-day service on a trial basis starting Saturday, 17 October, until 1 November.

Northbound departures from Kai Tak and Sung Wong Toi will run from 8am to 9pm, while southbound services from the port will operate from 8am to 11pm. The route takes as little as about 40 minutes via expressways including the Central Kowloon Bypass and Tai Lam Tunnel.

The operator said it applied for the extension after reviewing early operating data following the port’s opening on 12 October. It will consider making the all-day timetable permanent depending on passenger demand.
Separately, Citybus has added express trips on its B13 route during the Chung Yeung long weekend that skip Kam Tin and San Tin to shorten journey times from Hong Kong Island.

zh.headline: 城巴B14周六起試辦全日服務往返啟德及皇崗口岸
zh.dek: 北上班次由上午八時至晚上九時，南下班次至晚上十一時，試辦期至十一月一日，最快約四十分鐘可達口岸。
body: 城巴宣布，由周六（十月十七日）起重陽節長假期首日起，往返啟德、宋皇臺及新皇崗口岸的B14號線將以試辦方式延長為全日服務，首階段維持至十一月一日。
前往皇崗口岸的北上班次服務時間擴展至每日上午八時至晚上九時，由口岸開出的南下班次則為上午八時至晚上十一時。路線取道中九龍繞道及大欖隧道等快速公路，最快約四十分鐘可達口岸。
城巴表示，口岸十月十二日啟用後已審視營運數據並向運輸署申請延長服務時間，其後會視乎乘客需求考慮恆常化全日安排。
另外，為配合重陽節假期，城巴B13號線即日起加開不經錦田及新田的特快班次，縮短由港島前往口岸的車程。
